title: Prediction Strategies Module
summary: This module provides advanced prediction strategies for DSPy programs, including techniques for iterative refinement, agentic reasoning with tools, code execution, and multi-chain comparison to enhance output quality and robustness.

nodes.label: Select Best Prediction
nodes.title: BestOfN Strategy
nodes.description: Executes a given module multiple times and selects the best output based on a reward function or a predefined threshold, improving prediction quality.

nodes.label: Execute Code with Tools
nodes.title: CodeAct Strategy
nodes.description: An agent that generates and executes Python code within an interpreter, leveraging predefined tools to iteratively solve complex problems.

nodes.label: Compare Multiple Reasoning Chains
nodes.title: MultiChainComparison Strategy
nodes.description: Takes multiple reasoning attempts as input, compares them, and synthesizes a refined, more accurate reasoning and answer.

nodes.label: Generate & Execute Python Programs
nodes.title: ProgramOfThought Strategy
nodes.description: Generates Python code to solve problems, executes it in a sandboxed interpreter, and iteratively refines the code based on execution results or errors.

nodes.label: Reason & Act with Tools
nodes.title: ReAct Strategy
nodes.description: Enables an LLM to reason about a task, select and execute external tools, and iteratively refine its approach based on tool observations.

nodes.label: Refine Predictions with Feedback
nodes.title: Refine Strategy
nodes.description: Executes a module multiple times, evaluates predictions with a reward function, and generates actionable feedback to improve subsequent runs if performance is below a threshold.

nodes.label: Inject Refinement Hints
nodes.title: WrapperAdapter (Refine)
nodes.description: An internal adapter used by the Refine strategy to inject hints, derived from previous feedback, into the module's input during subsequent refinement attempts.

nodes.label: Inspect Module Definitions
nodes.title: inspect_modules Utility
nodes.description: A utility function that extracts and formats detailed information about the input fields, output fields, and instructions of sub-modules within a given program.

nodes.label: Generate Module Feedback Signature
nodes.title: OfferFeedback Signature
nodes.description: Defines the structure for generating concrete, actionable advice for individual modules within a program, based on their performance and contribution to overall task failure.

nodes.label: Recursive Language Model (RLM)
nodes.title: RLM Strategy
nodes.description: A powerful module that enables an LLM to programmatically explore and solve problems by generating and executing Python code in a sandboxed REPL, leveraging tools and sub-LLM calls.

nodes.label: Base Module Abstraction
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.base_module.Module
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental `Module` class for all DSPy components.

nodes.label: Signature Definition
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.signature.Signature
nodes.description: Defines the structure and fields for LLM prompts and responses.

nodes.label: Tool Definition
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.runner.Tool
nodes.description: Represents a callable function or external service that an LLM can use.

nodes.label: DSPy Predict/CoT
nodes.title: dspy.Predict/ChainOfThought
nodes.description: Core DSPy primitives for making predictions and generating chains of thought.

nodes.label: Code Interpreter
nodes.title: PythonInterpreter/CodeInterpreter
nodes.description: Provides a sandboxed environment for executing Python code.

nodes.label: Language Model Client
nodes.title: dspy.LM
nodes.description: Interface for interacting with various Language Models.

nodes.label: Adapter Configuration
nodes.title: dspy.settings.adapter
nodes.description: Manages how prompts are formatted and adapted for different LLM APIs.

groups.label: Generative Strategies
groups.title: Generative Strategies
groups.description: Modules focused on generating initial predictions or multiple attempts for a task.

groups.label: Agentic/Tool-Using Strategies
groups.title: Agentic/Tool-Using Strategies
groups.description: Modules that implement agentic behavior by integrating external tools and code interpreters for problem-solving.

groups.label: Refinement & Selection Strategies
groups.title: Refinement & Selection Strategies
groups.description: Modules designed to improve or select the best output from multiple attempts, often involving reward functions.

groups.label: Refinement Support Components
groups.title: Refinement Support Components
groups.description: Internal components and utilities that facilitate the Refine strategy's operation, such as feedback generation and module inspection.
